svg.title: MERKLE TREES: sketchnote
svg.text: A tree of hashes: compare or verify huge datasets by looking at a handful of hashes.
Hash each block, hash pairs upwards to one root. One changed
byte changes only the hashes on its path to the root.
Compare roots, skip every matching subtree, descend into
mismatches. ~40 hashes find 1 bad range among a million.
proof size = tree depth: ~20 hashes for 1M blocks
Block + one sibling hash per level (~20 for 1M blocks)
recomputes the root; match the trusted root and it's genuine.
Trees must track writes, or be rebuilt before
Leaves cover ranges: one changed key flags
Hash leaves and internal nodes differently
with Merkle trees per key range: they compare
root hashes and walk down only the branches
that differ, exchanging a few dozen hashes
instead of scanning a billion keys."
